notes: Made.com UK (Next-operated storefront). robots.txt explicitly Disallows /clearance and /*/clearance (a legacy directive shared across Next's multi-brand robots template), which suggested a live Clearance section might exist behind crawler-blocking, so it was investigated directly. Probed /clearance (bare) and 10 department-level candidates (/shop/sofas/clearance, /shop/lighting/clearance, /shop/home-accessories/clearance, /shop/tableware/clearance, /shop/bedroom-furniture/clearance, /shop/dining-room/clearance, /shop/living-room/clearance, /shop/outdoor/clearance, /shop/storage/clearance, /shop/furniture/clearance): every one resolves to the site's generic catch-all template, auto-titled 'Buy <Dept> Clearance Online' but with search.totalResults:0 and byte-length identical to the confirmed-empty fallback pattern (verified this template is universal by requesting a nonsense slug, which produces the same shape) - i.e. these are not live categories, just SEO-friendly URL slots with zero inventory. The sitemap (12,150 category URLs + 47 collection URLs) contains zero 'clearance' entries. The site DOES have a live, populated 'Sale' facet at https://www.made.com/shop/f/feat-sale (robots.txt has a specific Allow override for exactly this one URL, confirming it is meant to be indexed) - 58 products, page title 'MADE Feat Sale', facets confirm feat:sale is the only active feature value present. Per the Sale-vs-Clearance test: this is NOT confirmed as Clearance - the theme/design-system JSON on every page defines 'sale' and 'clearance' as two visually distinct badge concepts (different sash colours, rgba(208,26,66,1) red for sale vs rgba(182,93,26,1)/rgba(239,122,34,1) orange for clearance), and the page's own isMerchandisedUrl metadata carries a 'saleOrClearance' field (blank/false on this URL) that the platform uses elsewhere to mark a URL as permanent-markdown clearance - it is not set here. There is no on-page copy, breadcrumb, or heading describing these 58 items as permanent markdown, outlet, final-sale, or end-of-line; it reads as a standard temporary reduced-price filter. Given every dedicated Clearance URL is confirmed empty/non-live and the only live discount listing is explicitly labelled Sale with no permanence signal, this leans Sale-not-Clearance, but is recorded below per brief guidance rather than silently dropped, since a genuine 'Sale' facet does exist and a reviewer may want to see it.

rows.evidence: SSR JSON: "search":{"totalResults":58,...} on https://www.made.com/shop/f/feat-sale (page title 'MADE Feat Sale'; facets.feat.facets=["feat:sale"])
rows.flag: MANUAL REVIEW: AMBIGUOUS SALE/CLEARANCE - this is the site's generic temporary 'Sale' facet (58 products), not a dedicated Clearance page. All /shop/*/clearance and /clearance URLs tested (11 total) return the site's generic empty catch-all template with totalResults:0, confirming no live Clearance listing currently exists on this storefront. Recorded for visibility only; recommend excluding as Sale unless business wants generic on-sale items counted as Clearance.
